guard: cotal_send still creates unknown channels, but the success receipt lets a caller tell a new name from a known one
why: Issue #989. A typo'd channel used to return the same success line as a send into a known
room. The discriminating assertion is that a caller can TELL, not that bogus send fails.
N1 restores the old identical success TEMPLATE (drop the receipt). The cell that
normalized success lines differ must redden. Raw strings still differ by channel name.
N2 makes closeChannelNames always empty, so a one-edit typo no longer names the match.
N3 makes every name look pre-existing, so the tool receipt never says new channel.
N5 makes the authed default the first concrete channel again: the live Cloud refusal on #announce.
N6 drops the refusal when no read channel is postable.
N7 sends the raw argument instead of the resolved default.
NO BUILD STEP: the suite imports ../src.

mutations.name: N1 the success line ignores the receipt, restoring identical words for typo and known
mutations.expectRed: cotal_send on a typo says new channel so the caller can TELL
mutations.cell: cotal_send on a typo says new channel so the caller can TELL
mutations.note: The reported defect: success words no longer distinguish a typo from a known room.

mutations.name: N2 close matches are never suggested
mutations.replace: if (false && name !== channel && editDistanceAtMostOne(channel, name)) out.push(name);
mutations.expectRed: send to a one-edit typo reports new and names the close match
mutations.cell: send to a one-edit typo reports new and names the close match
mutations.note: Without close matches the caller can still see new but cannot see the likely intended name.

mutations.name: N3 describeSendChannel always reports existing, so a typo looks like a known room
mutations.expectRed: cotal_send on a typo says new channel so the caller can TELL
mutations.cell: cotal_send on a typo says new channel so the caller can TELL
mutations.note: If every name is 'existing', the tool receipt is identical to the old success line.

mutations.name: N4 #1229 assertKnownMentions refuses an absent name in every view state with the old sentence
mutations.expectRed: 1229:e send under an unpopulated view that never populates refuses naming the view condition, not "unknown mention"
mutations.cell: 1229:e send under an unpopulated view that never populates refuses naming the view condition, not "unknown mention"
mutations.note: #1229: the unpopulated wait-and-recheck exists so a mention of a live peer is not rejected while the roster refills after a reconnect. Dropping the wait restores the reported defect: cell (e) sees the old 'unknown mention' refusal under a view that cannot support an absence verdict.

mutations.name: N5 the authed default is the first concrete channel read, restoring the refused #announce default
mutations.find: return isAuthed(config) ? concrete.find((c) => channelInAllow(config.allowPublish, c)) : concrete[0];
mutations.expectRed: an omitted channel goes to the first channel the agent may post to
mutations.cell: an omitted channel goes to the first channel the agent may post to
mutations.note: The live Cloud defect: an agent reading [announce, team.rocket] with post rights on team.rocket only sent to #announce and the broker refused it.

mutations.name: N6 no refusal before sending when the agent may post to none of the channels it reads
mutations.find: if (target === undefined && joined.some(isConcreteChannel)) return err(`Couldn't send: ${NO_POSTABLE_DEFAULT}.`);
mutations.expectRed: with no channel it may post to, an omitted channel is refused before sending
mutations.cell: with no channel it may post to, an omitted channel is refused before sending
mutations.note: Without the guard the send goes out with no channel, the endpoint picks the read-only one, and the broker refusal is the only signal.

mutations.name: N7 the resolved default is computed but the raw argument is sent, so the endpoint picks the read-only channel
mutations.find: const m = await agent.send(msg, target, mentions);
mutations.replace: const m = await agent.send(msg, channel, mentions);
mutations.expectRed: an omitted channel goes to the first channel the agent may post to
mutations.cell: an omitted channel goes to the first channel the agent may post to
mutations.note: The receipt would describe team.rocket while the message went to the endpoint default.
